explication: This repository is a multilingual algorithm-answer collection: readers find a problem or topic, then inspect or reuse a solution in a supported language. The README documents LeetCode, contest, LCOF, LCOF2, LCCI, JavaScript, and database collections, alongside topic-focused algorithm material. The supplied tree directly shows LCCI answers and basic sorting implementations; other documented collections are retained as catalog branches, but their source paths are unavailable here. Sampled sorting programs demonstrate standalone input–algorithm–output behavior; no shared runtime or central dispatch is evidenced.
